precise_hypothesis: Under matched causal observation/action/compute budgets, intervention-response prediction improves low-sample receiver-response and QoS-action ranking over full-future latent JEPA and identical supervised learning; simpleRLS/NNLS may reject the hypothesis.
causal_limits: TrueRTcoupling is label/oracle, not learned-model inference input.
Two static poses do not establish crosswarehouse/temporal/continual/federated benefit.
AP/power/activity changed jointly do not identify their separate effects.
Controllable response equivalence and value-equivalence principles have prior art.
production_status: Runtime transaction/fault handling work is in progress and unqualified; no productionSLA or globalSOTA established.
